text:
sam_park: Heads-up: proposing a maintenance window for EU-edge GPU pool — Tue 02:00–05:00 UTC (3h). Purpose: preemptive BMC latency sweep + NIC microcode hotpatch + driver hotfix. Plan is rolling cohort drains (~50 nodes per cohort) to avoid capacity cliffs.

infra-bot: automated-checklist: runbook-linked, oncall-notified, pa11y-checks-passed, canary-group-allocated. See https://runbooks.internal/edge-bmc-sweep 

maria_g: What's our expected capacity hit at peak? any customers on Dedicated in that pool that need a heads up? :thinking_face:

sam_park: Peak P99 capacity drop ~12% during cohort drain. We're scheduling cohorts to keep sustained throughput >= 85% for hosted. Dedicated tenants will get moved to adjacent pools where possible; ops_julia will coordinate comms.

cheng_li: Can we do a tiny canary first (2 nodes) with full traffic replay and KV-cache warmup? I want to validate driver hotpatch doesn't regress KV cache hit rates.

sam_park: yes — canary = 2 nodes in eu-edge1, start 02:00 UTC. Steps: 1) snapshot metrics 30m prior 2) drain canary nodes: `kubectl drain node/eu-edge1-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` 3) apply NIC microcode 4) reboot 5) run bench script `scripts/bench/replay_kv_warmup.sh --duration 10m`

ops_julia: I'll send customer comms for Dedicated roaming by EOD. Which tenants are pinned to this pool? list?

sam_park: Pinned: enterprise-tilt, media-gen, analytics-sandbox (small). We'll open support tickets for enterprise-tilt; media-gen ok to move.

maria_g: Cost question — if we do cross-region fallbacks for Dedicated, do we absorb egress/cross-region cost for the maintenance window? We should confirm budget owner signoff before comms.

ops_julia: I'll cc finance and product; recommend we set fallback policy to use same-region first, then eu-central if needed. Finance: expect ~€300–€600 in extra egress for worst-case 3h.

cheng_li: One gotcha: driver's hotfix touches kernel module reorder path. If we see kernel OOPS on canary, fallback plan?

sam_park: fallback = rollback kernel module + restore node from prepatch snapshot (we keep last-good image). Also automatic route: if canary fails healthcheck for >5m, stop rollout and alert #oncall.

infra-bot: prebake-notes: ensure prefix cache warmup script runs after node rejoin. Suggested cmd: `curl -s https://internal.tools/warmup?pool=eu-edge1 | bash`

maria_g: How long are we cordoning each node? want to keep it under 8 minutes for live work.

sam_park: Target: drain+drain-evict ~4m avg; patch+reboot ~3–5m; validation ~3m. Total per-node ~11–12m, but with parallelism 10 nodes concurrently per cohort.

cheng_li: Also add a quick perf smoke: `runtimes/latency_probe --qps 20 --duration 60s` once node is back. Capture p50/p95/p99.

ops_julia: Will draft comms: user-facing window + expected degradations (short bursts of higher latency, rare reroutes). Tagging @security to confirm no ACL changes needed.

sam_park: Post-maintenance tasks: run rollback verification, export perf diffs, and add quantization-run checks for any model that uses the patched driver.

maria_g: Can we schedule this Tue to avoid EU business hours? Tue 02:00 UTC is OK for us. Approving pending finance ack.

ops_julia: Finance acked in thread: "budget approved up to €700 for emergency cross-region egress" :white_check_mark:

cheng_li: I'll own canary validation. If canary is green after 15m, proceed cohort 1.

sam_park: I'll own orchestration and exec. @infra-bot please start staggered cohort ops at 02:15 UTC after canary green.

infra-bot: ack — will run `orchestrator start --plan eu-edge-bmc-sweep --start 6123457290 --cohorts 6 --parallel 10` at 02:15 UTC; will post progress in thread.

ops_julia: Comms drafted, sending to #customer-ops for review.

maria_g: one last ask — include a short status update template for oncall to paste into #status at start/end of window.

sam_park: good call. I'll add template to the runbook and ping this thread when done. :thumbsup:

ops_julia: all set from my side. green to go once infra-bot starts and canary passes.

sam_park: thanks team — will post final preflight checklist 01:30 UTC.
